deviations.why: Original had patient testimonials, but no real testimonial data is available in the intake. Section omitted to avoid fabricating testimonials.
Original had a booking form, but there is no booking flow in the data contract. Form omitted because it would be non-functional and could mislead users.
Original had a circle with '12 Years of Experiences', but no years of experience is provided. Statistic omitted to avoid false claim.

notes: CSS module for MedicCare theme, faithfully ported from Templatemo Medic Care. Fixed contrast issue by darkening --vt-accent-on-deep to #1a4d8f. Scoped all element selectors under .root to satisfy CSS Modules purity requirement. No !important used. All colors derived from original palette.
